title: U.S. Marines on Oshima Island for Tsunami Relief
description: On April 4, 2011, U.S. Marines with the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU) assist the Japan Self Defense Force and Japanese citizens by clearing debris during a humanitarian assistance/disaster relief mission at Uranohama Port, Oshima Island, Japan, in support of Operation Tomodachi.  (U.S. Marine Corps imagery by Lance Cpl. Brennan O'Lowney)
keywords: 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit, tsunami, earthquake, Operation Tomodachi, japan self defense force, Oshima Island, Uranohama Port, Brennan O'Lowney, tsunami disaster earthquake, USMCCOMCAM, Marines, Marine Corps, MEU, U.S., disaster
